name: Fractal Disjunction
community_notes: Scintillating Legions units (excluding Monsters) only; the unit can only be selected as the target of a ranged attack if the attacking model is within 18".

name: Glimmershift Portal
community_notes: Used at the end of the opponent's Fight phase on up to two Scintillating Legions units (excluding Monsters), or one Scintillating Legions Monster unit, that are more than 3" horizontally away from all enemy units; they are removed and placed into Strategic Reserves.

name: Sulphurous Veil
community_notes: Each time an attack targets this unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll (incoming modifier).

name: Cyberspirit Machinations
community_notes: Requires a friendly Thousand Sons Psyker unit within 6" of the Vehicle when used.

name: Ensorcelled Infusion
community_notes: Requires a friendly Thousand Sons Psyker unit within 6"; applies to ranged weapons equipped by Vehicle models in the unit.

name: Hex-Marked Armour
community_notes: Worsens the Armour Penetration of incoming attacks by 1 until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks.

name: Malevolent Animus
community_notes: Requires a friendly Thousand Sons Psyker unit within 6" when used; modifiers to saving throws are still applied (the exclusion is not encoded).

name: Mutate Landscape
community_notes: [APPROX] The controlled objective becomes mutated: it stays under your control until the opponent's Level of Control exceeds yours at the end of a phase, and while mutated each enemy unit ending a Normal, Advance, Fall Back or Charge move within range suffers D3 mortal wounds on a D6 roll of 4+; the hazard rider is encoded as an opaque grant.

name: Warpflame Gargoyles
community_notes: Used just after an enemy unit ends a Charge move within Engagement Range of the Vehicle; roll six D6, one mortal wound per 5+, then that enemy unit takes a Battle-shock test.

name: Arcane Focus
community_notes: Used just after taking a Psychic test for a model that Channelled the Warp, before resolving the Ritual; re-roll all of the D6 rolled for that test, including the additional Channelling die.

name: Desecration of Worlds
community_notes: The objective marker the unit is in range of remains under your control until the opponent's Level of Control over it is greater than yours at the end of a phase.

name: Destined by Fate
community_notes: Used just after a saving throw is failed for the Psyker model; the Damage characteristic of that attack is changed to 0. With fast dice rolling, select one of the failed saves.

name: Egotistical Power
community_notes: Select Imbued Manifestation, Psychic Maelstrom or Wrath of the Immaterium; that Kindred Sorcery ability applies to this unit instead of any other, even if it was already selected this battle.

name: Psychic Dominion
community_notes: [APPROX] Attacks made against this unit with Psychic weapons gain [HAZARDOUS] (encoded as an opaque grant) and models in the unit have Feel No Pain 4+ against Psychic Attacks.

name: Blessed Transmutations
community_notes: Used in your Command phase on a Tzaangors unit below Starting Strength within 12" of a friendly Thousand Sons Psyker model; return up to D3+1 destroyed models (excluding Characters) to the unit.

name: Deranged Ferocity
community_notes: Models within 3" of enemy models are eligible to fight and can target an enemy unit within 3" of them that is within Engagement Range of their unit.

name: Gift of Change
community_notes: [APPROX] Used on a just-destroyed Thousand Sons Character model (excluding Monsters); at the end of the phase add one Tzeentch Chaos Spawn unit of one model to your army, set up as close as possible to where the model was destroyed and outside Engagement Range.

name: Touched by Tzeentch
community_notes: The unit is eligible to shoot or declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced (one of the two, chosen when acting).

name: Twisted Mirage
community_notes: The unit arriving from Strategic Reserves can be set up anywhere more than 6" horizontally from all enemy units (more than 8" for a Monster unit); it is not eligible to charge this turn.

name: Implacable Guardians
community_notes: Each time an attack is allocated to a model in the unit (excluding Psyker models), subtract 1 from its Damage characteristic; the Psyker-model exclusion is not encoded.

name: Infernal Fusillade
community_notes: Applies only to inferno bolt pistols, inferno boltguns, inferno combi-bolters and inferno combi-weapons equipped by models in the unit; the weapon-name scoping is not encoded.

name: Revenge of the Rubricae
community_notes: Used just after a Thousand Sons Psyker model is destroyed within 6" of the unit; after the attacking unit has shot, this unit can shoot, but may only target the enemy unit that destroyed the Psyker (if eligible).

name: Unwavering Phalanx
community_notes: Used just after an enemy unit ends a Charge move within Engagement Range; each time an attack targets this unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll (incoming modifier).

name: Embroiling Energies
community_notes: Applies only to the unit's malefic curse weapon; the weapon-name scoping is not encoded.

name: Spell-warded Armour

name: Nethershriek Mind-Eater

name: Diabolic Savant

name: Duplicitous Malediction

name: Umbralefic Crystal
